current_profile_snapshot.groove_behavior: swung eighth feel with ride-led pulse and flexible comping; swing ratio varies with tempo/performance
current_profile_snapshot.phrase_behavior: 4/8-bar phrasing with call-response, pickups, turnaround energy and space for improvisatory lines
current_profile_snapshot.harmony_behavior: extended tonal harmony; ii-V motion, secondary dominants, substitutions and blues language available without forcing one progression
current_profile_snapshot.bass_behavior: walking bass structural baseline with chromatic approaches and chord-tone targets
current_profile_snapshot.percussion_behavior_if_applicable: ride pattern + hi-hat/backbeat accents + feathered/supportive kick as target permits; brushes optional
current_profile_snapshot.instrument_role_behavior: piano/guitar comping, acoustic/electric bass, drum kit, sax/brass/clarinet melodic roles
current_profile_snapshot.ensemble_player_behavior: rhythm section negotiates shared swing pocket; comping responds to phrases rather than repeating fixed blocks
current_profile_snapshot.arrangement_transformation: head/solo/head or sectional jazz form; density changes under solos and ensemble figures
current_profile_snapshot.dynamic_behavior: interactive accents and phrase crescendos rather than static velocity
current_profile_snapshot.articulation_behavior: legato/tongued horn lines, comping stabs, bass sustain, brush/stick differentiation
current_profile_snapshot.timing_humanization_behavior: microtiming is relational to swing pulse and ensemble role; no random jitter
current_profile_snapshot.continuous_performance_control: expression, articulation, breath and comping-density controls
current_profile_snapshot.sound_effects_intent: room/reverb restrained; target tone may be warm/natural
current_profile_snapshot.mix_prominence_intent: bass/ride time feel clear; melody and comping leave mutual space
current_profile_snapshot.production_mastering_intent: preserve transient nuance and dynamic headroom
current_profile_snapshot.manufacturer_adapter_requirements: sax/piano target voices may be electronic patches but must retain canonical role behavior
